title: Plastic interior. Ok with cold drinks, but not as good with hot drinks
text:
Plastic interior. Ok with cold drinks, but not as good with hot drinks. I waffle every morning between carrying a mug of iced tea or a double cappuccino with me to the barn. I have a couple of very good go cups from Built NY that are great at keeping things hot or cold for a couple of hours.

This is the first "Bubba" mug we've tried and it's ok, but not a replacement for my Built NY cups. This is nice looking and it fits perfectly in my F150 cup holders and it's been fine in the top rack of the dishwasher. The interior is plastic, the only stainless steel is a decorative wrap on the exterior.

I will use this for iced tea and Dr Pepper over ice because it is fine at keeping cold drinks cool for a couple of hours - not cold, but cool. As for coffee, well... I have a 15 minute drive to the farm and another few minutes to get gates unlocked and parked etc. The coffee was fine and hot. However, after sitting for 35 minutes while I feed horses, my coffee was tepid. It's just not good for my needs with hot drinks.

product_metadata.title: Bubba Classic Tumbler, 20 oz, Black
features: Keeps hot beverages hot and cold beverages cold for hours with no sweating thanks to dual-wall foam insulation
Tough and durable BPA-free construction features ergonomically designed handle with soft-touch grip
Hand-wash-only and not for use in microwave
description: The bubba Classic Insulated Travel Mug, 20 oz., is perfect for use in transit or at work. This mug is made of high-quality food-grade stainless steel, has dual-wall insulation to keep your drinks hot or cold longer, and features a stainless steel exterior band. Designed to fit most cup holders, it has an easy-drinking lid and features a locking flap to prevent spills. Holding about 3 cups, this bubba is the perfect size to get you going in the morning without slowing you down. At the end of the day, remember to hand-wash your mug and do not use it in the microwave. Rest assured..
